_comment: Single-target marginal-SNR scenario for the tracker stress test (C.2, missed detections). One target at moderate range moves at a low constant velocity, with amplitude tuned to land near the CFAR detection threshold. Random noise causes some frames to fall below threshold, producing CFAR misses that the tracker must absorb via coasting (max_coast) and Kalman prediction (process_noise_q). The intent is to drive Pd into the 0.5-0.7 band per frame so the tracker is exercised but not overwhelmed.
